_doc: Install policy for the adoptable product. T0 is the substrate anyone clones. A real portfolio's T1–T3 list lives in the operator instance, not here.

T0.name: substrate
T0.rule: Carries a contract other repos read. Losing it breaks the product.

T1.name: revenue surface
T1.rule: Deploys to a live domain or holds a paying product.

T2.name: vertical
T2.rule: Real work, bounded scope, no live deploy of its own.

T3.name: consolidation candidate
T3.rule: Fold into a parent or archive. The principal decides — an agent never archives a repo.
